narr: A slow moving upper level trough combined with deep moisture to produce heavy rainfall and flash flooding across portions of south-central Georgia. Rainfall totals between 5 and 8 inches were measured in a couple of days.
ev: Twin Lakes Road was closed due to flooding between the 4600 and 4800 block.
Highway 41 was closed at the eastern edge of Lake Park due to flooding.
The intersection of Old Valdosta Road and Wesley Allen Road was flooded.
There were a few reports of water over a few roadways in Brooks county.
The intersection of Highway 76 and Cornelius Road was flooded.
Flooding was reported near Val Del Road and Bishop Lane.
